name: supported-platforms
body:
Supported targets (six), each gated purely on GitHub currently offering a hosted native runner for it to this private repo:
- darwin/arm64 (Apple silicon macOS) — runner: macos-14 / macos-latest
- darwin/amd64 (Intel macOS) — runner: macos-15-intel / macos-26-intel
- windows/amd64 — runner: windows-latest
- windows/arm64 — runner: windows-11-arm
- linux/amd64 — runner: ubuntu-latest / ubuntu-24.04
- linux/arm64 — runner: ubuntu-24.04-arm

General rule: a target is supported precisely when GitHub currently offers a hosted native runner for it in this repo. If GitHub ever stops offering a runner for a target, that target silently drops out — not built, released or packaged — with no self-hosted or manual fallback. Every target follows this same conditional rule now; none is unconditionally "always" supported.

AC: each release contains exactly one binary per target for which a runner exists at release time — no more, no less.
